THE m18 FAN'S BOLT YAW IS NOT MASKED: sub_1D460 (EF:9962) writes the five-bolt barrage's heading as `v4x->yaw_0x1C_28 = v3 + Maths::sub_581E0_maybe_tan2(v9, &a2x->position_0x4C_76);` -- a RAW store of `wing offset + bearing` into an int16_t, with NO `& 0x7FF` anywhere in the function. The wings are {-226,-113,0,+113,+226} over a 0..2047 bearing space, so the two OUTER wings deliberately leave that space and the bolt flies carrying a yaw above 0x7FF (or below 0) until whatever consumes it folds the value at index time. The port masked on write, which is false on exactly those two wings of every fan -- an INVENTED WRITE of the rounds 83-84 class, and invisible on the three inner bolts. WITNESS mc2l15 pair 15433->15434, slot 2, the +226 wing of the (5,18) tank at slot 4 (MGC_WRITE_TRACE=2:f30 names the writer): the aimed bearing is 2035, retail stores 2261, and 2261 & 0x7FF = 213 -- exactly what the port wrote. The other four bolts of the same volley (slots 7/225/265/268) were bit-exact because their offsets kept them inside the mask, which is why this survived every earlier take. Landing it took mc2l15's horizon 15,433 -> 16,733. MGC_NO_MC2_FAN_YAW_UNMASKED=1 restores the mask.

So ANY action the IDLE PRIMITIVE itself moved to -- 194 included -- is overwritten with 198, the charge; only the acquire the handler runs ITSELF (sub_28690, inside the taken branch) survives at 194. KIND 4 IS A GUARDIAN TOO, AND THE DISPATCH IS CROSSED: sub_1D5D0's switch (EF:9985-92) sends case 3 to sub_1D7C0 and case 4 to sub_1D700 -- note the CROSS, the functions are not in case order. They differ in WHOM the guardian chases. sub_1D7C0 (kind 3): `if (dist3d(me, v3x) <= reach) { word_0x96_150 = v3x - struct_0x6E8E; StageVar2 = 10; sub_1E040(); }` -- the WATCHED ENTITY itself is the quarry. sub_1D700 (kind 4): `v4 = v3x->word_0x96_150; if (v4 && dist3d(me, Entities_EA3E4[v4]) <= reach) { word_0x96_150 = v3x->word_0x96_150; StageVar2 = 10; sub_1E040(); }` -- the guardian INHERITS whatever the watched entity is hunting and measures the reach to THAT. The port had the kind-3 body right and gated the whole arm on `kind == 3`, so a kind-4 guardian never woke at all. Retail reads the inherited quarry's position with no liveness test (hence Gen::mc2_target_raw) and COPIES the handle verbatim, so the port's PLAYER_TARGET sentinel propagates exactly as retail's human slot does. WITNESS mc2l15 pair 19905->19906, slot 4, a stage-held (5,9) at sv2 4 whose watch handle (sv_timer = retail's word_0x4A_74) is slot 66 on BOTH sides: retail reads slot 66's own word_0x96_150 = 165, the human, measures the reach to IT and inherits it -- sv2 4 -> 10, action45 79 -> 74 (8m+7 -> 8m+2), target96 0 -> 165. The port held every one at the phase-7 wait. TRAP RECORDED: reading the mapping off the FUNCTION ORDER rather than the case labels inverts the two laws, and the inverted version fires at the right tick with the wrong quarry -- measured WORSE than not firing (horizon 19,905 -> 19,750). MGC_NO_MC2_HELD_KIND4_GUARD=1 restores the kind==3 gate.
